concerns.text: Task T005 (preprocess GWTC posterior samples) references inverse‑probability weights from T008 (see T008) but T008 is defined later in Phase 3. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer dependency; T008 must precede T005 or T005’s description must be revised to remove the weight dependency.

Functional requirement FR‑017 (lag‑1 autocorrelation check) and success criterion SC‑012 are not represented by any task. Add a task (e.g., T017) that computes the lag‑1 autocorrelation on the final i.i.d. point‑estimate dataset and enforces |ρ₁| < 0.1, producing an appropriate JSON artifact.
